purpose: Deployment shopping overlay: destination, retailer enablement, and personal browser/profile policy. Supplied to the shared ghostship-shopping core at runtime; technical routing lives in ghostship-tools.

localities._note: Approximate town centroids, used only to rank practical nearby stores when a provider gives an address but no distance.

account_policy.accounts: Shopping browser methods are assigned to the user-designated Assistant profile. The runtime remains disabled until its separate gate permits use.
account_policy.memberships: The operator's memberships on those sign-ins count when pricing, but only as the session shows them for the offer; never assume a membership the page does not show.
account_policy.read_only: Research only: never add to cart, check out, order, or change account settings.
account_policy.payment: Never add payment cards to any store account.
account_policy.privacy: Never record the operator's name, address, phone, order history, or account identifiers in logs, docs, or evidence; record only whether a session is signed in and which membership badges the page shows.
account_policy.profiles: Assistant is the shopping profile and the Google web-client profile (both protected and leased; Google web sessions are broker-mediated). Default is the non-personal agent profile for general, newsletter, and apk-acquisition work.
account_policy.context: Recipes may set a site's store or delivery ZIP; in Assistant this can change the operator's saved preferences, so check the current context first and change it only when it differs from the requested destination.

safeway.membership: Safeway club card (free) for club prices

browser_qualification.detail: walmart.com search showed a 'Robot or human?' hold-button challenge in an ordinary browser session; not used.

walmart.membership: walmart-pp-cli uses no account; operator memberships in the Assistant profile apply only to browser checks that show them.

costco.membership: Costco membership needed to buy; warehouse prices are read without a login.
